# liblsl

`lsl.dll` is the native [liblsl](https://github.com/sccn/liblsl) library for 64-bit Windows, version 1.15.2, shipped unmodified so that a Windows build works out of the box: `polarble.exe` finds it in its own directory, and the release zip packages the two together.

liblsl is distributed under the MIT licence by its authors; see the [upstream repository](https://github.com/sccn/liblsl) for the full text. On Linux and macOS, install liblsl from its releases instead.
